name: verdant-scepter-enter-banishes-a-slime-for-power-plus-one-refinement-counters
notes: Verdant Scepter had no implementation of its Class Bonus On Enter or its ability. Added $enterAbilities['7wsxirq146:0']: MAY banish a Slime ally, then put (power + 1) refinement counters on the Scepter (found again by UniqueID, since banishing the Slime shifts field slots). The champion is patched TAMER (Class Bonus) with a TERA lineage card; the Scepter is materialized on turn two (its memory cost is paid by the seeded memory card). The opportunity window opened by the new field ability is left pending.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: You may banish a Slime ally you control. If you do, put an amount of refinement counters on CARDNAME equal to the banished ally's power plus 1.

engineBug.summary: Verdant Scepter's On Enter was not implemented.
